candidate_windows.window_text: The UpDn model uses pretrained Faster R-CNN (Ren et al., 2015) to extract top $K$ object feature embeddings. We set $K = 36$ in our implementation, and the dimension of each object features is 2048. For question embeddings, we preprocess the questions to a maximum of 14 words. The word embeddings are initialized with pretrained GloVe (Pennington et al., 2014) vectors with dimension of 300. A single-layer GRU (Cho et al., 2014) is used to obtain question embedding vectors with the dimension of 512. The dimension of the joint embedding is 2048. The initial learning rate of Adamax optimizer and learning rate decay schedule are followed to the public reimplementation<sup>2</sup>. The entire system is trained end-to-end with both $L_{vqa}$ and $L_{c}$ . The parameters are initialized from scratch and the random seed is set to 0. The loss weight $\lambda_{vqa}$ and $\lambda_{c}$ are respectively set to 1 and 2. We set batch size to 512. The model developed on the official public Pytorch codebase<sup>3</sup> takes about 5 hours (~30 epochs) to train on a Nvidia RTX 2080Ti. Both Q-CSS and V-CSS are used to generate $(Q, Q^{+}, Q^{-})$ and $(I, I^{+}, I^{-})$ .
